title: Stabilize-then-optimize: Feedback transformations as preconditioners in optimal control
summary: Many numerical algorithms for optimal control leverage an elimination of the state via the control-to-state map such as condensed approaches or preconditioned conjugate gradient methods for the optimality system. As such, the norm of the control-to-state map directly enters the convergence estimates for these methods, e.g., via the condition number of the associated linear system.
